title: Offline listed-index futures/options research references
inspection_note: These records preserve the prior planning-turn primary-reference inspection, including direct versus indexed provenance. They are not a claim of fresh retrieval, current product eligibility, replicated performance, or data redistribution rights.

sources.title: CME Chapter 353: Micro E-mini S&P 500 Stock Price Index Futures
sources.supports: Contract-specific multiplier and outright tick example; not a margin, live quote or contract-discovery feed.
sources.limitations: Marketing contract-spec HTTPS returned 403; official indexed rulebook and product results corroborated the example. No claim of a direct rulebook download.

sources.title: Kite Connect 3 market data and instruments
sources.supports: Daily CSV reference metadata differs from live quotes; exact exchange/symbol binding, absent response keys and explicit bid/ask depth matter.
sources.limitations: The page's advertised batch cap differs from its changelog. No Kite adapter or entitlement is implemented by M1.

sources.title: Kite Connect historical candles
sources.supports: Current instrument tokens and continuous futures candles do not themselves reconstruct point-in-time expired-contract selection or option-chain history.
sources.limitations: Reference inspection only; no authenticated historical data was requested.

sources.title: Kite Connect exceptions and rate limits
sources.supports: Any later data adapter needs source-category pacing and explicit handling of auth, throttle and transport failures.
sources.limitations: No later live adapter is enabled or promised by this reference.

sources.title: NSE Clearing equity-derivatives settlement mechanism
sources.supports: Index exercise/fixing and cash settlement context; the initial pure engine explicitly requires supported cash European contracts.
sources.limitations: Summary text conflicts with the NIFTY product description and is not a universal current certification for stock derivatives. Resolve effective circulars before live support.

sources.title: NSE Clearing equity-derivatives margins
sources.supports: Margin is sourced risk collateral with multiple components, not a universal loss cap or the user's available account funds.
sources.limitations: M1 accepts only labelled reference evidence and never reads an account or verifies affordability.

sources.title: OIC Black-Scholes formula overview
sources.supports: Option-model inputs include underlier, strike, time, volatility, dividend and rates; a simple spot model must not silently replace American-exercise modeling.
sources.limitations: Educational model context is not validation of TradeGuard forecasts or thresholds.

sources.title: OIC understanding option Greeks
sources.supports: Greeks are model sensitivities rather than guaranteed premium changes or probabilities of profit.
sources.limitations: Units, year fraction and contract scaling are explicitly defined by this implementation.

sources.title: NSE NIFTY 50 derivatives product page
sources.supports: Product-specific identity and specifications must be checked rather than guessed from generic F&O labels.
sources.limitations: Observed page text calls NIFTY options physically settled while the clearing summary describes cash exercise. M1 does not resolve this into an automatic live eligibility rule.

sources.title: Hermes native plugin guide
sources.supports: Public register(ctx) tool/configuration surfaces and inert loading; validation is distinct from installation and catalog admission.
sources.limitations: Actual installed-runtime doctor/validate runs remain required; documentation inspection alone is insufficient.

sources.title: QuantLib analytic European engine primary source
sources.supports: European-model scope and positive spot with dividend/risk-free discount inputs provide a primary implementation reference.
sources.limitations: Mutable master reference, no revision/license reuse audit. No QuantLib code was copied, vendored or installed; any future reuse requires an exact revision and license review.

sources.title: Kite Connect API changelog
sources.supports: Versioned endpoint/authentication changes and advertised limit conflicts require explicit implementation limits and source-version review.
sources.limitations: Future feed integration must recheck current documentation and actual entitled payloads.
